# Teachers.Net

> > Teachers.Net is a comprehensive online community for educators featuring 24/7 teacher chat, 200+ discussion boards, lesson plans, and teaching job resources.

Founded by Anthony Bott, Teachers.Net serves as a global hub for teacher collaboration with specialized chatboards for every grade level and subject area, from early childhood through high school. The platform connects educators worldwide through mailrings, live chat, curriculum resources, and career support forums.

## Key Topics

- Teacher chatboards and discussion forums
- 24/7 live teacher chat
- Lesson plans and curriculum resources
- Teaching jobs and career support
- Grade-level communities (early childhood, elementary, middle school, high school)
- Subject-specific forums (music, science, social studies, arts)
- Special education and GATE/ATP programs
- New teacher and student teacher support
- Teacher mailrings and email communities
- Administrator resources
- Substitute teacher support
- Pen pals and project collaboration
- Education technology tools
- Teacher professional development

## Teacher Community & Chat

- [Teachers.Net Homepage](https://teachers.net): Main hub for teacher resources, chat, lesson plans, and teaching jobs with 150+ mailrings and chatboards
- [Teacher Chat Center](https://teachers.net/chat): 24/7 live discussions for teachers with grade-level and subject-specific chatboards worldwide
- [Teacher Chatboards & Mentors](https://teachers.net/mentors): Active discussion network with 200+ chatboards for teacher collaboration and mentoring
- [Chatboards Directory](https://teachers.net/forum/chatboards): Complete listing of all teacher chatboard categories and forum discussions

## About & Information

- [About Teachers.Net](https://teachers.net/info): History of Teachers.Net and story of founder Anthony Bott

## Account Support

- [Email Preferences](https://teachers.net/email-preferences): Manage mailring subscriptions and email notification settings
- [Password Recovery](https://teachers.net/password): Reset password and recover account access for teacher portal
- [Unsubscribe](https://teachers.net/unsubscribe): Manage or cancel mailring and email subscription preferences

## Optional

- [Advertising Opportunities](https://teachers.net/advertising): Marketing and advertising services for education-related businesses
- [Test Forum](https://teachers.net/testforum): Testing environment for chatboard functionality
